title: Petition of Crystal Transportation, Inc. of 82 Crestview Road, Needham, Massachusetts, for a temporary 120-day license under the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 5, as amended, for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire as a restricted common carrier over certain public ways in the Towns of Wellesley, Brookline and Weston and the Cities of Boston, Newton and Cambridge.
